home.heroSubtitle: Premium boutique legal services in real estate, foreign investment, corporate and immigration.
home.whoWeAreTitle: Since 1978, GM Attorneys has guided high-net-worth clients through real estate, foreign investment, and immigration in Costa Rica. We were the first firm to make the coast our home, not a branch — and that presence still sets us apart.
home.whoWeAreText: A premium boutique firm rooted in Guanacaste and San José. We combine local insight with decades of experience to deliver personalized, precise legal counsel to investors and buyers who expect nothing less.
home.apartIntro: A boutique firm is measured by its judgment, not its size. For over four decades we have earned the trust of investors and buyers who chose Costa Rica —
home.apartHighlight: pairing the reach of an international practice with the closeness only a local partner can offer.
home.teamIntro: Behind every transaction is a team of attorneys, notaries, and advisors chosen as carefully as the cases we take on.
home.teamHighlight: From partners with over four decades at the bar to counsel who have served on the country's highest court, our people are the firm.
